Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that John Baxter died later (1975) than S. Roy Luby (1976). The data gathered in Step 9 clearly showed S. Roy Luby died on August 19, 1976, while John Baxter died on January 21, 1975. Since 1976 is later than 1975, the director of Boot Hill Bandits died later. The Planner failed to perform the correct chronological comparison of the verified dates, leading to a false conclusion that the director of Say It With Flowers died later.
